- Modified by: Our Many Worlds project
- Initial adaptation date: 2026-07-27

The independent runtime under `apps/openovel-runtime` adapts the upstream
foreground context capsule, Recent Canon continuity, post-narration options,
append-only Canon, and asynchronous Storykeeper execution order. It does not
copy OpenNovel branding, Electron UI, image/TTS/export modules, or desktop
packaging.
